_doc: Canonical gates spec for transcript-step-read-check.py (Workstream B item-5 read-before-work canary).
Boundary = orchestrator TaskUpdate(status=in_progress) keyed by metadata.step (post-B per-step dispatch
signal, SKILL.md 'Per-step dispatch'); contract = the matching steps/NN-*.md lazy-load file. One gate per
apex step. Replay a captured /apex session JSONL via replay-canary.sh, or directly:
transcript-step-read-check.py --transcript <jsonl> --gates step-gates.json [--json]. Steps not reached in a
run read NOT-RUN (no violation); a step that worked off a stale/absent contract read reads FAIL.
